sources.name: Spansh celestial body surveys
sources.notes: Station associations, additional named facilities and ring hotspot counts are taken from matching body records. EDSM facilities take precedence by market ID. Source survey timestamps are retained.

notes: Sizes and orbit spacing are visually compressed by the renderer. Positions are schematic, not live ephemerides.
0 shared barycentres are preserved from EDSM parent chains; their unreported orbital elements remain null.

Raw material percentages are body composition data, not commodity deposits. Ring hotspot records report commodity signal counts; exact positions and overlaps are unknown. No surface resource sites are inferred from body signal counts.
Curated resource locations are an independent optional layer supplied through the reusable canonical location interface, rather than copied into this celestial snapshot.
